stories.name: ActionBar
stories.summary: The row of actions a view ends on.

stories.name: Avatar
stories.summary: A person, by their picture or by their initials.

stories.name: Badge
stories.summary: A status or a count, read at a glance and never pressed.

stories.name: Button
stories.summary: The thing a person presses to make something happen.

scenes.title: With an icon or a shortcut

stories.name: Calendar
stories.summary: A month grid: one day, or a span of them.

stories.name: Callout
stories.summary: Something the reader should know before they go on.

stories.name: Card
stories.summary: A surface that holds one thing apart from what is around it.

stories.name: Checkbox
stories.summary: A choice that stands on its own, or one of several that may all hold.

stories.name: Code
stories.summary: Something to be typed exactly, in a line or as a block.

stories.name: Collapsible
stories.summary: One section that can be put away.

stories.name: Combobox
stories.summary: One value out of a list long enough to be searched.

stories.name: DateRangePicker
stories.summary: When something starts and ends, chosen in one sheet.

scenes.title: The product’s own presets and durations

stories.name: Dialog
stories.summary: A question the rest of the window waits on.

stories.name: Divider
stories.summary: A rule between two things that are not the same thing.

stories.name: Drawer
stories.summary: A panel that comes in from an edge and leaves by it.

stories.name: EmptyState
stories.summary: What a list says when there is nothing in it.

stories.name: Form
stories.summary: Fields that are sent together, and checked before they are.

stories.name: FormField
stories.summary: A control with the label that names it and the hint under it.

stories.name: Icon
stories.summary: A glyph, set at the size and in the colour of the text beside it.

scenes.title: In the colour of its text

stories.name: IconButton
stories.summary: A button that is only its glyph, with the label kept for a reader.

stories.name: KeyCap
stories.summary: A key, drawn the way the keyboard shows it.

stories.name: Link
stories.summary: Somewhere to go, set in the line it is read in.

stories.name: Menu
stories.summary: Actions kept out of the way until they are asked for.

stories.name: Meter
stories.summary: How much of something there is, against how much there could be.

stories.name: NumberField
stories.summary: A number, stepped or typed, with the unit it is counted in.

stories.name: OptionCard
stories.summary: One of a few, where each needs a sentence to be chosen by.

stories.name: OtpField
stories.summary: A code, a character to a box.

stories.name: PillTabs
stories.summary: Tabs that carry a count, for a list cut several ways.

stories.name: Popover
stories.summary: A small panel that stays with the thing it was opened from.

stories.name: Preferences
stories.summary: Settings, a row to each, in the sections they belong to.

stories.name: PreviewCard
stories.summary: What a link leads to, shown before it is followed.

stories.name: Progress
stories.summary: How far along something is, or that it is under way at all.

stories.name: Radio
stories.summary: One of a few, with every option in view.

stories.name: SearchField
stories.summary: A field that filters what is already on screen.

stories.name: SectionLabel
stories.summary: The small heading over a group of things.

stories.name: SegmentedControl
stories.summary: A few views of one thing, and the one being looked at.

stories.name: Select
stories.summary: One value out of a list that is too long to lay out.

stories.name: ShortcutRecorder
stories.summary: A field that takes the keys pressed in it as its value.

stories.name: Sidebar
stories.summary: The column a window is navigated from.

stories.name: Skeleton
stories.summary: The shape of what is coming, while it is on its way.

stories.name: Slider
stories.summary: A value along a range, where the feel matters more than the figure.

scenes.title: With its value, and a range

stories.name: Spinner
stories.summary: Work in progress that has no length to report.

stories.name: Splitter
stories.summary: Panes that share a window, and the seam between them.

stories.name: StepList
stories.summary: A job in stages, and the stage it has reached.

stories.name: Switch
stories.summary: A setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped.

stories.name: Table
stories.summary: Rows of the same kind of thing, lined up to be compared.

stories.name: Tag
stories.summary: A label a person can pick, or take away.

stories.name: TextField
stories.summary: A line of text, or several, that a person writes.

stories.name: Toast
stories.summary: What just happened, said once and then gone.

stories.name: Toggle
stories.summary: A button that stays pressed.

scenes.title: A group, one at a time

stories.name: Tooltip
stories.summary: The name of a thing that has no room to say it.

stories.name: Tree
stories.summary: Things inside things, opened a level at a time.
